Name: Immersive Farm 2
Author: halloikbenzander
Description:
[size=4]I am sorry to say I will not be updating this mod anymore. I have not been interested in stardew valley for a long time. I always feel compelled to answer every comment, and I'm tired of it. Recent SV update also broke the mod in some way, and I don't feel like fixing it. You can still download the mod if you want to play it and click the spoiler button for the description.

Please do not PM me for help with the mod as I will not respond anymore. For any help you need with installing mods you can go to stardew valley discord.[/size]


[size=5][spoiler]
[/size][color=#6aa84f][b][quote][size=5][center]FEATURES[/center][/size][/quote][/b][/color]
- Dedicated Farming Fields
- Dedicated Animal Fields (The entrances have invisible walls that prevent animals from escaping)
- Relocated and expanded Greenhouse. Now has space for 360+ Crops (Optimized for vanilla Iridium Sprinkler) and 12 Fruit Trees
- Relocated and expanded Cave. The Cave has 3 minecart shortcuts that provide quick access to remote areas of the farm
- Minecart network access on the Farm and Cave. However the Cave version can not be traveled to from other areas
- A few other shortcuts around the farm
- Second Entrance to the Bus Stop
- A new area on the west side of the farm which connects to the Secret Woods
- Permanent 'Shed' to place your kegs and whatnot
- Spa/pool to recover Energy (Locked behind Steel Axe and Pickaxe to prevent cheating in early game)
- A Tunnel to the Pool
- A matching World Map
- Many custom tiles / sprites made by me, and others

The latest version of the map is slightly different than the screenshots on this mod page

These features were removed due to the required mods being incompatible with SV 1.3. They will be added back in the future
(i know these mods had been updated again)
- Quarry
- Foraging
- Minecart traveling to the farm

[color=rgb(97, 97, 97)][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2256?tab=description]MTN[/url][/color] support will be added ONLY when that mod is finished and when proper instructions on how to use it are provided


Multiplayer info:
- Prebuilt cabins do not work, they are bugged and you have to buy them from carpenter instead
- There is a bug on this map which doesn't cause it to display in the co-op menu. To fix it you need to first buy a cabin from the carpenter and save the game.



[color=#ffff00][b][quote][size=5][center]REQUIRED MODS[/center][/size][/quote][/b][u][b]
[/b][/u][color=#ffffff]This mod does not contain any of the required mods files. You must still download those seperately!

[color=#ffff00]MAIN FILE (Content Patcher version)[/color][/color][/color]
[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348/?]

And I recommend to install 7zip for easy drag and drop installation of the downloaded files[url=https://ninite.com/7zip/]
Download 7zip
[/url]
[color=#ffff00]INCOMPATIBILITY[/color]
While this mod is installed it is not possible to play on ANY other farm map / farm type! Any mod that changes the following maps is incompatible!
Forest
Woods
BusStop
FarmCave
Greenhouse
Farm


[quote][b][center][i][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/i][/center][/b][/quote]
1. Download all required mods and install them first
2. Download this mod and open the zip file
3. Copy the "[CP] Immersive Farm 2" folder to Mods folder located where you installed Stardew Valley
4. In game start a new character and choose the default standard farm.

If you want to play this map as co-op you will have to buy cabins from the carpenter first, or else it won't work. Prebuilt cabins do not spawn.


[color=#ff0000][size=4]Uninstallation[/size][/color]
Navigate to Stardew Valley/Mods and delete "[CP] Immersive Farm 2" folder

[size=4]
[/size][color=#ffff00][size=4]OPTIONAL COMPATIBILITY MODS[/size]
[/color]If you have any of the following mods, also download optional compatibility file:
- Eemies Recolour
- Starblue Valley
- Starry Sky Interface
- Vintage Interface[s]
[/s]- Less Yellow Stardew[s]
[/s]- Even More Secret Woods
- Errosavia's Tree Happy Greenhouse
- 15x10 Greenhouse
[s]
[/s][color=#ffff00][size=4]Compatibility Mods Installation[/size][/color]
They should be installed only AFTER the main file

1. Download the file and open the zip file
2. Open the folder for the mod you want to install
3. Copy the "[CP] Immersive Farm 2" folder inside to the Mods folder where you installed Stardew Valley. Overwrite any files when asked.
4. Read any additional txt files included for more information or instructions[s]

[/s]When you install a compatibility mod, you should remove the affected files in the original mod. If the mod only changes 1 file then you can delete the whole mod. Example: If the only file the mod changes is greenhouse.tbin then you could delete the whole mod. But if the mod changes greenhouse.tbin and it adds a new tilesheet then you should only delete greenhouse.tbin[s]
[/s]
To know which files are affected look in the Assets folder
[s]
[/s]

Downloads.Description: This is for Stardew Valley 1.3 only and uses Content Patcher

This changes the main farming area to a single big dirt field similar to the original vanilla farm.
To install extract the Farm.tbin file to the Assets folder found in the "[CP] Immersive Farm 2" mods folder.
